shortDescription: Completed a 12-week industrial training program focused on Java full-stack development.
description:

The internship provided practical exposure to full-stack development, including Java-based backend development, frontend technologies, database integration, and software development workflows.

shortDescription: Worked as a Full Stack Developer Intern on the Fooddify food ordering platform.
description:
